rationale: All three review lenses ran. All 5 acceptance criteria pass. Commit format matches the EPMCDME pattern. No blocking findings. Two deferred items noted: (1) the !isTemplate guard also suppresses any navigationSlot passed to template cards — intentional per spec and technical analysis, no current callers pass both; (2) the test uses a full-document queryByRole query rather than scoping to the template-cards list container — the test is correct and catches the regression today, but would give a false failure if a future layout NavigationMore is added without a dataTooltipContent. Both are noted for future improvement and do not block this change.

business_review.criterion: The three-dots menu is not displayed on any workflow template card on the Templates page.
business_review.notes: WorkflowTemplates.tsx passes isTemplate={true} to WorkflowCard. The !isTemplate guard added in the diff suppresses the entire WorkflowActions / navigationSlot block for all template cards.

business_review.criterion: Users cannot access View Details, Copy Link, or Clone from a template card.
business_review.notes: WorkflowActions (which renders all three actions) is inside the guarded block and is no longer rendered for templates.

business_review.criterion: The Create Workflow button and card layout remain visually unchanged.
business_review.notes: The Create Workflow button is in the isTemplate-true branch at lines 244-254, which is untouched. The h3 reformatting in the diff is cosmetic only (no class or logic change).

business_review.criterion: Regular workflow cards in WorkflowsList continue to show the three-dots menu (no regression).
business_review.notes: WorkflowsList.tsx does not pass isTemplate, so it defaults to false. The guard evaluates to !false, rendering the block exactly as before.

business_review.criterion: The new integration test fails if the guard is removed.
business_review.notes: Removing the guard causes WorkflowActions -> NavigationMore to mount with aria-label='More options', which the .not.toBeInTheDocument() assertion will catch.

standards_review.notes: Commit 'EPMCDME-13544: Remove three-dots menu from workflow template cards' matches the enforced EPMCDME-NNNN: Capital sentence pattern. No period at end.
Change is a pure conditional render with no security surface (no auth, secrets, input handling, or data contracts affected).
